name: modelflare
description: Image and video generation in Gemini CLI with one Modelflare Smart API Key.

settings.name: Modelflare Smart API Key
settings.description: One key for every image and video model available to your account. Create one at https://modelflare.dev/keys (sign up: https://modelflare.dev/sign-up?utm_source=gemini-cli&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=integrations).

settings.name: Modelflare base URL
settings.description: global (default, https://modelflare.dev/v1), china (https://origin.modelflare.dev/v1), or a custom base URL. Leave empty for global.
